blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Voting 13-6-1, the Senate impeachment court decided to continue voting on the conviction threshold in Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial. Senator-judge Alan Peter Cayetano had earlier urged the court to defer the issue and instead ask the Supreme Court to determine the number of votes required to convict Duterte./dp READ: Watch: Sara Duterte impeachment trial | Sept. 23, 2026...
